hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted by key, compact separators and finite numbers; distinct from native RFC 8785 identity hashes.
scope: Every scenario/profile supplies all mutable native scalar parameters in their exact declared units. Immutable basis parameters stay at declared defaults. Initial states, doses, covariates and solver protocol remain separate. One complete convention applies to every readout of a run; differences between profiles are source conventions, not evidence of failed biology. The current archive default uses displayed 0.693. Physical dimensions, population inference and complete paper reproduction remain unqualified.
